one_line: A textile trader and coin minter from Sultanate-era Malwa, navigating cotton routes and fiscal workshops between Mandu and the ports of Gujarat.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s, lean but sturdy build from travel and workshop work.
appearance.face: Oval face with a warm medium-brown Malwa complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, slightly arched brows, and large sharp anime-style eyes with a thoughtful, calculating default expression that softens when he smiles.
appearance.hair: Dark brown-black hair pulled back into a small low knot at the back of the head, with a few loose strands near the temples, covered by a soft white cotton pagri (turban) wrapped flat and low, with a narrow indigo band near the base.
appearance.costume: A long, knee-length, side-tied cotton angarkha in undyed off-white with a subtle fine vertical stripe weave, worn over a light grey-blue cotton jama-style inner tunic, paired with narrow churidar-style pyjama trousers in muted indigo; a simple leather waist belt in dark brown holds a small cloth purse and keys, and over one shoulder drapes a light, handwoven cotton shawl in pale beige with a thin double border of maroon and dark green, hinting at Chanderi-like finesse; on his feet are plain brown leather mojari-style shoes; he wears a modest silver ring on his right hand and a narrow silver bracelet on his left wrist symbolising his prosperous but practical status.
appearance.signature: A rectangular wooden coin-die block and small metal hammer held together in one hand, with a looped cloth pouch of mixed silver and billon coins from Mandu hanging at his belt, a few coins visible showing tiny Nagari and Arabic-Persian scripts side by side.

ref_desc: A late-20s Malwa merchant-minter with medium-brown skin, short beard, dark hair in a low knot under a white turban, wearing an off-white angarkha, indigo churidar trousers, beige bordered shawl, brown mojari shoes, and carrying a wooden coin-die block, hammer, and coin pouch in off-white, muted indigo, pale beige, maroon, and dark brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a late-20s Malwa Sultanate merchant-minter: medium-brown complexion, oval face, short neatly trimmed beard and moustache, large sharp eyes with a thoughtful expression; dark brown-black hair pulled back into a small low knot at the back of his head, with a few loose strands at the temples, covered by a soft white cotton turban wrapped flat and low with a narrow indigo band near the base. He wears a knee-length, side-tied cotton angarkha in undyed off-white with very subtle fine vertical stripe texture, over a light grey-blue inner tunic, paired with narrow muted-indigo churidar-style trousers. A simple dark brown leather waist belt holds a small cloth purse and keys, and over one shoulder is a light pale-beige handwoven cotton shawl with a thin double border of maroon and dark green, suggesting refined Chanderi-like cloth. His feet are in plain brown leather mojari-style shoes, and he has a modest silver ring on his right hand and a narrow silver bracelet on his left wrist. His signature tools are a rectangular wooden coin-die block and a small metal hammer held together in one hand, while a looped cloth pouch of mixed silver and billon coins from Mandu hangs at his belt with a few coins visible showing tiny Nagari and Arabic-Persian scripts; use a restrained palette of off-white, muted indigo, pale beige, maroon accents, and dark brown leather details, and present him clearly from head to toe for consistent redrawing.
